name: Occidental-Novena
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws tidally locked hemisphere, patient as erosion itself.
Standing still, you feel the scorching air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Debris from escape pod debris field rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
